note: The arcology's lit panes and lamp lenses. Six of them glow through their materials' glow maps, so each has a day material that is the same material without it (`dayMaterials`, written by `tilekit daylight --materials`): as its own day texture such a pane was as bright at noon as at night (2026-11-24). A mesh that draws one of the six is lit whatever its own glow, and is left none: the game tints a glow map by it. glass and arcology_win02 have no material and are their own day textures. A pane shows at its mesh's own alpha. Left lit at every hour: the signs and the monument (fcx_pub, kuhmu, bespin_monument2), the water (tcn01_watrstn02) and the glowing metal trims (c_metall, bb1bottom, dgt04_chrome, lsf_grate01), and the wall console's lights (imp_modules_id5: its glow map and its blinking lamps, docs/tilesets/fcx01/blink.json).
